'''Linsa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Garos IV]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], during the time when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was consolidating its hold over the planet, she worked as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Magir Paca]], the influential [[Assistant Minister of Commerce]].<ref name="Turning Point" />
